expo.name: PilotABC
expo.description: Train the ICAO/NATO phonetic alphabet: timed sprints with speech recognition, pronunciation, listening drills and aircraft registrations. Available in German, English, French, Italian and Spanish.

infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: The app listens to you during an exercise so it can recognise and score the code words you speak (e.g. “Alfa, Bravo”). Nothing is recorded or stored.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Speech recognition turns your spoken code words into text so the app can mark them right or wrong. Where possible this happens directly on your iPhone.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: PilotABC does not access your photo library. The permission is only declared because a built-in file component supports it; the app never asks for it.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: PilotABC does not save anything to your photo library. The permission is only declared because a built-in file component supports it; the app never asks for it.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: PilotABC does not use the camera. The permission is only declared because a built-in system component supports it; the app never asks for it.
